//: A skin is this folder copied to skins/<id>/ with this file filled in. Every key is optional: anything left out comes from the base look (Skin.qml BASE, Style.qml). Keys starting with // are notes and are ignored. Folders starting with _ are never listed. See docs/SKINS.md.
label: TEMPLATE
//label: the name on Settings' SKIN row
//osName: what the assistant calls the desktop out loud
//hidden: true: listed only after skins are unlocked (the app search's hidden word or `qs ipc call skin set`)
//presets: built-in colour presets; glyph is shown on the Settings tile and flares on the ignite. Custom presets are shared by every skin.
//aliases: other names that resolve to one of these presets, e.g. another skin's: { "CYAN": "BLUE" }
//glyphs: ring: signs set round the clock, the lock seal and the skin transition (any count; [] = bare rings). sun: the seal's centre sign.
//personas: display names of the two personas (ids stay jarvis / friday; the wake word stays "hey Jarvis"). name: labels; call: in a sentence and spoken; accent: a fixed colour for the persona's marker, "" = the theme's.

text.cursorHint: The busy cursor turns while apps load · off shows a still frame

//text: the HUD's wording: bar name, panel titles, lock / unlock messages, the hyprlock title, denied text, password placeholder and fingerprint lines, the unlock / power-down words and the power menu's title ({name} = the greeting name), glyphs on the lock buttons and the bar's corner (mark "" = the preset's glyph), the skin transition's title, host = the diagnostics wall's user@host name
//style: tokens for the shared components (Style.qml). mono: data and body; display (+ displayCaps, displayScale): headings. frame: holo | engraved. texture: holo (scanlines / grid) | grain | none, grain / grainDark its strength 0..1 (grainDark on very dark presets). glow: halo multiplier. corners: four glyphs for engraved frames' corner notches. divider: glyph at a divider's centre. gauge: ring | astrolabe. metalRule: brushed-metal rule beside headings. surface: 0 glass … 1 stone plate. The values here are the base look.
//components: optional overrides, files in this folder: { "clock": "MyClock.qml", "scene": "MyLock.qml", "transition": "MyTransition.qml", "notifCard": "MyNotif.qml" }. Start from the defaults (AlchemCircle.qml, VaultScene.qml, TransmuteTransition.qml) and keep their properties. Put `import "../.."` under `import QtQuick`.
//namer: SAVE AS PRESET's suggestions: { "entries": [{ "name": "COBALT", "glyph": "", "h": 215, "s": 0.7, "l": 0.45 }, …], "compound": true, "joiner": "-" }. h in degrees, s and l 0..1; the nearest entry to the primary colour wins, compound pairs it with the accent's. null = plain colour names (RED, TEAL, SILVER…).
//voices: the skin's default voices: { "orrin": { "voice": "bm_george", "speed": 0.94, "pitch": -0.5 }, "selene": { … } } with an "effect" per persona or one "effect" for both (Kokoro / piper voice names as in Settings; effect presets from jarvis/effects.json). Applied the first time the skin is used; after that whatever is set in Settings is remembered per skin. null = keep the current voices.
//cursor: a folder here with wait.svg / progress.svg busy-cursor templates (see alchemos-cursor/src for the placeholders); "" = the default art
